name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys discovered motorsport through his grandfather, a former rally mechanic, spending countless hours in the garage learning the intricacies of engine building. He started his career in logistics, ensuring parts arrived on time for a small racing team, before transitioning into a more technical role assisting with data analysis during testing. He excels at coordinating test schedules and ensuring drivers have everything they need to provide useful feedback. Rhys is meticulous and believes that detailed preparation is the key to unlocking performance on the track. 

He views his role as bridging the gap between the engineering team and the drivers, facilitating clear communication and fostering a collaborative environment. He is driven by a desire to see the team constantly improve, and he is known for his calm demeanor even under pressure. Rhys is always looking for ways to optimize testing procedures and improve data collection methods, making him a valuable asset to any team aiming to refine their car setup and driver performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a slightly athletic build, and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to the cafeteria.
Insists on double-checking all schedules, even if confirmed by multiple people.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
